# plot_percolation_windows { #mofography.threejs_viz.plot_percolation_windows }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Windows and PLD-critical markers along percolating paths.

```python
threejs_viz.plot_percolation_windows(
    analysis,
    atoms,
    probe_radius=None,
    pld_tolerance=0.25,
    **kwargs,

```

Return ``{windows, pld_critical}`` trace dict bundle (functional API).
